title: US: symptoms outpace diagnoses and medication
context: Reported trouble with memory and concentration has risen more than three times as fast as depression diagnoses, and about seven times as fast as medication for depression.
ask: If more people are struggling, where are they going for help, and what are they being asked when they get there?
